name: Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia
alt: German Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia

predecessors.name: Czechoslovakia
predecessors.text: 'the remaining Czech parts of Czechoslovakia' that German troops entered on the morning of 15 March 1939

successors.name: Czechoslovakia
successors.text: the Czech lands; the infobox names the Third Czechoslovak Republic as successor

ledger.x: 16 March 1939: Hitler proclaims the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia from Prague Castle.
15 March 1939: German troops occupy the Czech lands.
8-9 May 1945: German rule ends in the Czech lands.

wars.name: Prague uprising
wars.outcome: The Czech uprising began 5 May 1945; the Wehrmacht capitulated 8 May and Soviet troops took Prague on 9 May during the Prague offensive, ending the Protectorate.

certainty.note: The border with the Reich follows the October 1938 Sudetenland line, itself set by the Munich Agreement; the Protectorate's land boundary did not change in six years.
